jobs.title: Staff AI-Native DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the team

The Conversational AI team at ServiceNow builds the core platform behind ServiceNow Otto, our conversational AI experience. We are a group of applied scientists and software engineers working at the intersection of research and production. Our work spans the full stack that makes Otto capable: agent orchestration, including harness engineering, prompt tuning, agent skills, policy design, and quality evaluation across languages; the A2A and MCP protocols that let agents collaborate and connect to tools; background channels and conversational triggers that bring agents into action; AI-native licensing and pricing; and the central caching layer that connects the ServiceNow platform to the services powering Otto.

We are seeking a Staff AI-Native DevOps Engineer
to join a new DevOps practice within the Conversational AI team. You will own the build, deployment, and reliability of the systems behind ServiceNow Otto, our conversational AI platform, from commit through production across our SaaS environments. Your work will span CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure on Kubernetes, observability, and the operational tooling that lets agent orchestration, MCP and A2A services, and the central caching layer ship safely and frequently. You will partner closely with applied scientists and software engineers to make AI-native delivery repeatable, measurable, and secure. This role combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code with a practical understanding of how ML and LLM-based services behave in production, and a bias toward pragmatic engineering with measurable impact on deployment velocity and service reliability.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native applications and infrastructure.
Strong software engineering skills, with experience developing infrastructure tooling and automation using Go, Python, or similar languages.
Experience leading complex infrastructure initiatives, establishing engineering best practices, and driving adoption across multiple teams.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed systems issues and drive improvements in performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Strong understanding of modern AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic architectures, with the ability to apply these concepts to engineering and operational challenges.
An AI-native engineering mindset, proactively leveraging AI tools and automation to accelerate development, improve operational efficiency, and deliver more intelligent, resilient systems.

DevOps

Deploy, scale, and operate distributed microservices in production Kubernetes environments, including managing application lifecycle, networking, security, and service reliability.
Design and implement infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Kubernetes-native tooling, including Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Kubernetes Operators.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, and ArgoCD to automate testing, deployment, and release management.
Implement observability, monitoring, and incident response practices, performing root cause analysis and driving remediation to improve availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.
Architect and optimize cloud infrastructure across public and private cloud environments, with an emphasis on security, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational simplicity.

AI Skills

Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at your level — it applies to how you build and to what you build.

Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other — catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready.
AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt.
Understanding of LLM-powered application architectures, including model inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agentic workflows, with an awareness of their infrastructure, scalability, and reliability implications.
Ability to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot AI-powered services in production, including managing model API integrations, observability, latency, resource utilization, and operational costs.

Minimum Requirements

8+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or related experience.
6+ years of experience deploying and operating containerized applications and distributed services in production environments.
4+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure automation.
Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Go, Python, or Bash, with experience building production-grade automation and tooling.
Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools in software engineering workflows, with demonstrated ability to validate, debug, and safely integrate AI-generated code.
Working knowledge of LLMs, Generative AI, and agentic AI concepts, including their integration patterns and operational considerations.

Preferred Requirements

8+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering.
Extensive experience architecting and operating Kubernetes-based SaaS platforms at scale, including multi-service deployments and complex production environments.
Experience developing Kubernetes Operators, custom controllers, or other Kubernetes-native automation to manage application lifecycle and infrastructure operations.
Demonstrated technical leadership in driving cross-team infrastructure initiatives, improving production reliability, and establishing scalable platform engineering practices.
Hands-on experience deploying, integrating, or operating LLM-powered applications or agentic systems in production environments. Experience building AI-enabled infrastructure automation, observability, incident diagnosis, or remediation workflows to improve platform reliability and engineering productivity.

, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production-ready AI agents at scale. AgentCore Harness, launched at AWS Summit New York in June 2026, provides a managed agent loop that enables customers to define an agent through configuration rather than build and operate orchestration infrastructure themselves.

Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, test, deploy, and operate core components across the Harness control plane and data plane. You will solve challenging distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low-latency streaming. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, contribute to technical designs, and deliver high-quality solutions for customers.

Harness sits at the intersection of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, and Evaluations. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle.

A central part of this role is making sophisticated agent capabilities dramatically easier to use. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. Your work will help customers move from an idea to a secure, observable, production-ready agent in minutes while preserving the flexibility advanced builders need for customization.

You will help develop capabilities that make agent development faster and more accessible. This may include simplifying how customers connect tools and memory, building richer agent templates and skills, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the build-test-deploy loop, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release changes.

This is an opportunity to join a newly launched service at an early stage, contribute to its architecture and customer experience, and deliver capabilities with broad industry impact. Machine learning experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for strong engineers with distributed systems experience, sound technical judgment, a commitment to operational excellence, and the ability to deliver in a fast-moving environment.

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, test, deploy, and operate highly available control plane APIs, data plane services, and managed agent loops for production AI agents.
Build secure, isolated execution capabilities spanning tool orchestration, memory, context management, streaming, identity, networking, observability, and failure handling.
Develop integrations between Amazon Bedrock and third-party models, AgentCore services, MCP servers, AWS Step Functions, Strands Agents, and customer-defined environments.
Implement versioning, endpoints, progressive deployment, rollback, evaluation, and optimization capabilities that help customers safely improve agent behavior.
Analyze and improve latency, scalability, availability, resource efficiency, and cost controls across multi-tenant workloads.
Simplify the developer journey across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local workflows by building cohesive abstractions, templates, defaults, and automation.
Work directly with customers and partner teams to identify and reduce friction, accelerate time to production, and balance approachable experiences with the flexibility advanced builders need.
Contribute to architectural decisions within Harness and collaborate with teams across AgentCore. Help raise the engineering bar through design reviews, operational readiness, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

AI Foundations Specialist Models Data Science team builds and ships state of the art scalable architecture, AI/ML solutions for Capital One’s award-winning mobile app. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver app features that delight customers with dynamic and personalized experiences, enable them to chat with Capital One’s digital assistant Eno, or search for useful contents. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate and create next generation experiences powered by the latest emerging generative AI technologies.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Hugging Face, LangChain, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Be the expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), adapt and finetune them for customer facing applications and features.
Build machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.

Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Soft Matter Simulations
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

Your role will involve applying soft matter physics and molecular simulation expertise to accelerate the discovery, optimization, and understanding of complex soft matter systems. You will use coarse-grained and atomistic modeling, mesoscale simulation, analytical theory, and agentic AI systems to investigate polymers, colloids, surfactants, gels, liquid crystals, and formulated fluid systems with direct relevance to commercial applications.

You will work at the intersection of physics-based simulation, AI/ML, and autonomous scientific workflows. The focus is on using computational insight to identify promising formulations and material compositions, explain structure-property relationships, guide optimization campaigns, and help agents reason over simulation and experimental data in scientifically grounded ways. Desired simulation expertise covers atomistic and coarse-grained molecular dynamics, mesoscale approaches such as dissipative particle dynamics, Monte Carlo sampling, and analytical theory including self-consistent field theory, field theoretic simulation, and liquid state theory.

This is a hands-on research role for someone who can connect deep soft matter and molecular simulation expertise with software development and practical scientific impact. You will collaborate with computational scientists, AI researchers, software engineers, and experimental teams to turn simulations, models, and scientific reasoning into robust software, agentic frameworks, and closed-loop scientific workflows.

What You'll Be Building

Implement, extend, and deploy atomistic, coarse-grained, and mesoscale simulation capabilities for soft matter systems, including MD, DPD, SCFT, Monte Carlo, and liquid state theory
Engineer simulation software with modern scientific libraries, emphasizing testing, modularity, and reproducibility at scale on HPC and cloud infrastructure
Translate simulation outputs into descriptors and datasets for ML models, and build predictive models to guide formulation selection and optimization
Develop and deploy agentic AI systems that leverage simulation capabilities for autonomous scientific discovery and closed-loop experimentation
Communicate physical insights, model limitations, and recommendations to computational, ML, and experimental collaborators

What You'll Need To Succeed

PhD in chemical engineering, physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field (or master's with equivalent experience)
Strong background in soft matter physics covering polymers, colloids, surfactants, gels, or liquid crystals, with hands-on expertise in atomistic and coarse-grained MD
Working knowledge of at least two of: DPD or other mesoscale methods, Monte Carlo, SCFT, field theoretic simulation, or liquid state theory
Strong Python scientific software development skills; fluency with modern practices including version control, testing, code review, and packaging
Experience running and automating simulations at scale on HPC or cloud, and integrating computational predictions into experimental or closed-loop optimization workflows
Good familiarity with agentic AI systems, autonomous scientific workflows, or simulation-aware agents

Bonus Points For

Experience with a compiled language (C++, Rust, or Fortran) for performance-critical simulation code, or GPU acceleration via JAX or PyTorch
Contributions to open source simulation packages such as LAMMPS, HOOMD-blue, GROMACS, or OpenMM
Experience developing ML potentials or applying AI/ML to soft matter simulation data and molecular property prediction
Experience building agents that reason over or orchestrate simulation workflows, or coupling simulation to active learning and Bayesian optimization pipelines
Publication record in soft matter theory and simulation

CompensationWe offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range: $176,000 USD - $304,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Who are we?

Versant Health is one of the nation’s leading administrators of managed vision care, serving millions of our clients’ members nationwide. We are driven by our mission to help members enjoy the wonders of sight through healthy eyes and vision.

See how you can make a difference with the support of strong leadership and a team environment.

See Everything, Be Anything™.

What are we looking for?

The Senior Data Scientist is a principal‑level individual contributor responsible for architecting, delivering, and governing enterprise‑grade advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that materially influence strategic decisions, financial performance, operational efficiency, and regulatory posture.

This role operates at the intersection of data science, data engineering, cloud analytics platforms, and business strategy, serving as a technical authority and thought leader across complex, high‑risk analytical initiatives—particularly within regulated healthcare environments.

The Senior Data Scientist is accountable not only for model development, but for explainability, stability, auditability, and long‑term operational viability of analytical solutions deployed at scale within the Microsoft data ecosystem.

Where you will have an impact

Architect, design, and deploy advanced statistical, predictive, and machine learning solutions that support enterprise‑level decision‑making across healthcare, operations, finance, and customer/member domains.
Own end‑to‑end analytical solution lifecycle, including data discovery, feature engineering, modeling, validation, performance monitoring, retraining strategy, and retirement planning.
Serve as a technical authority on model explainability, fairness, robustness, and regulatory defensibility—particularly where ground truth or forward‑looking forecasts are limited.
Design analytics solutions natively within the Microsoft cloud analytics stack, ensuring alignment to enterprise data architecture and governance standards.
Partner closely with executive stakeholders, data engineering leaders, and platform owners to translate complex business questions into high‑impact, production‑ready analytics.
Lead and influence analytics standards without direct authority.
Define best practices for: model documentation, audit artifacts, model risk management, stability analysis, reproducibility, and controlled experimentation.
Guide and review work produced by other data scientists, analysts, and vendors to ensure technical rigor and business relevance.
Present complex analytical findings to senior leadership using clear narratives, decision‑oriented visuals, and quantified trade‑offs.
Proactively identify analytical risks, data limitations, and downstream impacts of modeling decisions.
Continuously evaluate emerging tools, methodologies, and Microsoft platform capabilities to drive modernization and performance gains.

What’s necessary to do the job?

Master's degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or related field required.
7–10+ years of progressive experience delivering advanced analytics or machine learning solutions in complex, data‑rich environments.
Required: Prior experience in healthcare analytics (payer, provider, life sciences, or regulated healthcare data domains).
Prior acutrary experience a plus.
Proven experience deploying production analytics or ML solutions supporting mission‑critical business processes.
Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow where appropriate)
SQL (advanced T‑SQL optimization, analytical patterns)
ML explainability and governance techniques (e.g., SHAP‑style approaches, stability testing)
Deep, hands-on, production experience across sizable portion of the Microsoft analytics ecosystem, including:
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Analytics, Notebooks)
Azure Synapse Analytics (dedicated & serverless SQL pools)
Azure Data Factory (Fabric Data Pipelines)
Azure Data Lake Storage
Azure Machine Learning (model training, deployment, monitoring)
Power BI (semantic models, DAX optimization, executive dashboards)

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Basic Function

HF Sinclair's Data Scientist develops and continually improves production artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions that support enterprise decision-making and automation. This hands-on technical role spans business problem definition, experimentation, model development, deployment, and ongoing evaluation.

The role applies statistics, traditional machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and agentic AI to enterprise use cases. The Data Scientist owns model development, evaluation, and continuous improvement; partners with engineering teams on deployment and operational controls; and mentors junior data scientists while collaborating with business and client-facing teams.

Job Duties

Translate business challenges into clearly defined AI/ML use cases, measurable success criteria, appropriate evaluation methods, and feasible technical approaches.
Data quality and readiness: Assess data completeness, accuracy, representativeness, and potential leakage before developing models.
Design, train, validate, and optimize machine learning models using structured and unstructured data; conduct exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical testing, and error analysis.
Evaluate, adapt, and fine-tune pre-trained models, including NLP, deep learning, and large language models (LLMs), for specific enterprise and domain requirements.
Build and improve GenAI and Agentic AI solutions, including retrieval-based workflows, tool integration, agent orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review where appropriate.
Develop reproducible training and evaluation pipelines, and work with engineering teams to productionize solutions with appropriate versioning, deployment, and operational controls.
Own continuous improvement of deployed models and AI agents: monitor accuracy, reliability, drift, unexpected behavior, latency, and cost; investigate issues and drive model refinement or retraining.
Collaborate with data engineering, application, platform, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, explainable, and maintainable solutions.
Apply responsible AI practices, including transparency, model observability, governance, documentation, and appropriate privacy and risk controls.
Document architectural choices, experiments, model limitations, and reusable approaches; conduct technical reviews and mentor junior data scientists.
Communicate results, trade-offs, risks, and business impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders; contribute technical expertise to solution design and presales discussions.

Special assignments or tasks assigned to the employee by their supervisor, as determined from time to time in their sole and complete discretion.

Experience

Six or more years of hands-on experience in applied data science, machine learning, or AI, including responsibility for model development and production deployment or support.

Education Level

A minimum of a Bachelors Degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or other related fields, or equivalent work experience in lieu of a four-year degree is required

Required Skills

Proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience in data processing, model development, and machine learning libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Ability to apply statistical methods, supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, and rigorous evaluation.
Hands-on experience with NLP and generative AI techniques, including LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and model adaptation or fine-tuning.
Experience developing or integrating AI agents and evaluating their quality, reliability, and behavior in enterprise workflows.
Understanding of production machine learning practices, including reproducible pipelines, model registries, versioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and retraining.
Experience working with complex structured and unstructured datasets.
Familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), application programming interfaces (APIs), and container-based deployment concepts.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with production machine learning tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow.
Exposure to Snowflake or similar enterprise data platforms.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith or Langfuse, and with enterprise AI security and governance requirements.
Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into practical, measurable solutions.
Technical ownership and engineering judgment, including the ability to balance model quality, explainability, delivery effort, and operating constraints.
Clear communication, client and stakeholder engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and technical mentorship skills.
Curiosity and adaptability, with a disciplined approach to evaluating and applying emerging AI capabilities.

Benefits

HF Sinclair offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families. Our benefits include, but are not limited to, the following:

Medical Insurance
Vision Insurance
Dental Insurance
Paid Time-Off
401(k) Retirement Plan with match
Educational Reimbursement
Parental Bonding Time
Employee Discounts

We are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment, ensuring our employees have the resources needed to thrive professionally and personally. Benefit eligibility is governed by official plan documents, for more details visit Total Rewards.

Our One HF Sinclair Culture

At HF Sinclair, we are united through our One HF Sinclair Culture, which is underpinned by our five core values of Safety, Integrity, Teamwork, Ownership and Inclusion. Developed to empower our people, our five core cultural values are at the heart of everything we do and extend to how we engage our stakeholders. These values influence our decisions, shape our behaviors and keep us connected across the entire organization. We maintain a true Safety culture for our employees, communities, environments and customers. Our goal is to make sure everyone returns home safely each day. We have a long-standing commitment to Integrity and ethical behavior and do what is right for our employees, investors, communities and the environment. We encourage employees to Step Up and Stand Out by championing a culture of Teamwork and Ownership. We foster a culture of Inclusion by encouraging diversity of experiences, viewpoints and backgrounds. What makes each of us different, together makes us stronger.

About HF Sinclair Corporation

HF Sinclair Corporation, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is an independent energy company that produces and markets high-value light products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, renewable diesel and lubricants and specialty products. HF Sinclair owns and operates refineries located in Kansas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Wyoming, Washington and Utah. HF Sinclair provides petroleum product and crude oil transportation, terminalling, storage and throughput services to our refineries and the petroleum industry. HF Sinclair markets its refined products principally in the Southwest U.S., the Rocky Mountains extending into the Pacific Northwest and in other neighboring Plains states and supplies high-quality fuels to more than 1,750 branded stations and licenses the use of the Sinclair brand to more than 350 additional locations throughout the country. HF Sinclair produces renewable diesel at two of its facilities in Wyoming and also at its facility in New Mexico. In addition, subsidiaries of HF Sinclair produce and market base oils and other specialized lubricants in the U.S., Canada and the Netherlands, and export products to more than 80 countries.

Established relationships with multiple areas of interaction.

Proficiency in statistical programming languages such as R, Python, SAS, or similar, alongside general programming and SQL knowledge.
Demonstrated experience building and deploying statistical and machine learning models to address business challenges.

Experience with AI/ML model testing, validation, deployment, and integration into CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with tools such as MLflow for model experimentation and registration, Git for version control, and agile frameworks using tools like Azure DevOps.

Develop and project manage modeling projects and statistical analyses.
Effectively communicate results to business partners and help drive business decisions.
Participate in creation and discussion of best practices and propose new techniques.
Mentor junior team members.

Sr. Data Scientist: 4 or more years of data science/predictive analytics experience in (re)insurance or 6 or more years predictive modeling experience in another industry.

Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Statistics/Math and Economics double major, or Statistics/Math and Computer Science double major or Statistics/Math and Operation Research double major

Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities

The Science Challenges Include

Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life

Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About The Team

Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of building models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++

American Modern Insurance Group, Inc., a Munich Re company, is a widely recognized specialty insurance leader that delivers products and services for residential property – such as manufactured homes and specialty dwellings – and the recreational market, including boats, personal watercraft, classic cars, and more. We provide specialty product solutions that cover what the competition often can’t. We write admitted products in all 50 states and have a premium volume of $2.2 billion.

Headquartered in Amelia, Ohio, and with associates located across the United States, we are part of Munich Re’s Global Specialty Insurance division. Our employees receive boundless opportunity to grow their careers and make a difference every day - all in a flexible environment that helps them succeed both at work and at home.

Join our dynamic, centralized Data Science team as we execute our AI/ML roadmap! We focus on developing and maintaining predictive models that support all domains across the business. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with senior data scientists to build and support AI/ML and Gen AI models. You will test models to ensure efficacy and compliance before deployment, work hand-in-hand with ML Engineers to deploy models and verify system performance, and monitor models post-deployment, making adjustments as needed. Join us in building AI/ML models that truly drive business value and make a measurable impact.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Build and deploy AI/ML models with general guidance.
Act as a liaison between the ML Engineers and Data Science team, managing AI/ML model deployments and conducting testing.
Participate in the development of modeling presentations and present results/topics to stakeholders (internal & external) and management as requested.
Concentrate on loosely defined problems which require application of creative approaches. Contribute to projects that yield actionable insights the business can use to increase customer satisfaction, policy growth, retention, and profitability.
Complete required data preparation, including data input with guidance. Identify data anomalies and seek guidance on necessary adjustments.
Identify data and operational issues requiring specialized analytics attention, data scrubbing, and modeling techniques.
Document and communicate assumptions, results, and alternatives to team members and internal stakeholders with guidance.
Create and maintain modeling best practices and new techniques in coordination with internal and external business partners.

Schedule and prioritize workload demands. Maintain very good organization skills. Complete technical peer reviews as needed.
Maintain strong interpersonal skills - listen deeply, ask correct questions, take notes, complete professional oral and written business communications (including email communications), presentations, and build business relationships in order to better understand insurance company processes and functions. Established relationships with multiple areas of interaction.

Required Technical Skills:

Proficiency in statistical programming languages such as R, Python, SAS, or similar, alongside general programming and SQL knowledge.
Demonstrated experience building and deploying statistical and machine learning models to address business challenges.
Skilled in data wrangling, quality evaluation, transformation, and cleaning for analysis.
Experience with AI/ML model testing, validation, deployment, and integration into CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with tools such as MLflow for model experimentation and registration, Git for version control, and agile frameworks using tools like Azure DevOps.

Develop and project manage modeling projects and statistical analyses.
Effectively communicate results to business partners and help drive business decisions.
Participate in creation and discussion of best practices and propose new techniques.
Mentor junior team members.

Sr. Data Scientist: 4 or more years of data science/predictive analytics experience in (re)insurance or 6 or more years predictive modeling experience in another industry.

Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Statistics/Math and Economics double major, or Statistics/Math and Computer Science double major or Statistics/Math and Operation Research double major

One role, three levels. You do not pick yours before applying; the team places you at the level your skills and scope earn during the process, and the offer matches it.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗔𝗡𝗬
Pave Talent is hiring on behalf of our client, a venture-backed robotics company under 200 people building autonomous ground robots for industrial inspection, infrastructure, energy, and public safety customers. The robots run on customer sites, on unstructured terrain, in real weather, today. Perception is the constraint on what the platform does next, which is why this hire matters more than the headcount suggests.

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝘀 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲
- Researchers who became engineers. You care about the algorithm and you care just as much about whether it runs at frame rate on the robot's compute
- People who ship. The team's hardest hiring problem is candidates who can explain a method beautifully and have never taken one to production
- Engineers who take direct feedback in a code review, change the approach, and move on
- Anyone who wants their work measured against physical terrain instead of a leaderboard
This is not the role if you want to spend two years deepening one research thread, or if your only deployment target has ever been an offline dataset.

𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗥 𝗔𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗟𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡
You own a piece of the perception stack outright, not a ticket queue inside someone else's. Your algorithm goes on a robot within weeks and field data comes back. Lead is open now if you want direct reports. Senior and Staff stay fully individual contributor if you do not.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬
The platform is being pushed into harder environments and perception unlocks them. The team is expanding what the robot handles across perception and manipulation: graded stairs, grating, and bridge structures, the geometry that breaks most localization stacks. You take perception from research to reliable production software alongside the robotics, controls, and systems engineers.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗕𝗨𝗜𝗟𝗗
- Design and implement SLAM and localization systems, visual, visual-inertial, lidar, or multi-sensor
- Build computer vision pipelines for feature extraction, tracking, mapping, and scene understanding
- Implement and optimize estimation algorithms, both filtering and optimization-based
- Fuse data from cameras, inertial measurement units (IMUs), lidars, and depth sensors
- Evaluate perception performance against real-world field data and hard metrics
- Optimize for real-time performance and robustness on the robot's onboard compute
- Work with the controls and planning teams to support downstream autonomy
- Build out the tooling, datasets, and evaluation frameworks the team runs on

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗧𝗔𝗟𝗞
This team has interviewed roughly 100 people across their open software roles and has not hired. The failures cluster: live C++ under observation, explaining a technical decision clearly, absorbing feedback in the room, and turning a concept into a finished product rather than an interesting prototype. The other consistent gap is candidates who cannot pivot off a long-horizon lab project into product cadence. Research background is welcome here; the hiring managers actively want lab experience. What they need with it is someone who can close.

𝗤𝗨𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗙𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦
𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱:
- A master's in robotics, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field plus 2+ years of relevant experience, or a PhD. Equivalent industry experience counts; the team weighs what you built and shipped over where your degree is from
- Hands-on experience implementing SLAM or localization on a real system, not just in simulation
- Solid command of 3D geometry and coordinate transformations, camera models and calibration, feature-based or direct visual methods, and probabilistic state estimation
- Proficiency in C++ and/or Python. Expect a live C++ exercise in the process
- Linux environments and a robotics software stack such as Robot Operating System (ROS / ROS 2)
- At least 2 years in a complex physical product domain, robotics, automation, or aerospace, or equivalent research lab work on real hardware
- Permanent U.S. residency, and the ability to clear standard background checks before and during employment
- On-site in Philadelphia five days a week. There is no remote option for this role

𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀:
- SLAM frameworks: ORB-SLAM, VINS, Cartographer, or GTSAM
- Lidar-based perception and mapping
- Deep learning perception models
- Perception deployed on real robots in the field
- Graphics processing unit (GPU) acceleration with CUDA or OpenCL
- Dataset curation and annotation
- Publications in robotics or computer vision, paired with industry delivery experience

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗩𝗜𝗘𝗪 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦
Five steps, and you will know where you stand at each one.
- A 30-minute technical screen with us at Pave Talent before anything goes to the client
- An initial phone screen with their people team
- A 45-minute technical conversation
- A live CoderPad coding interview with team members
- An on-site final focused on collaboration and fit

𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝗕𝗘𝗡𝗘𝗙𝗜𝗧𝗦
𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆: $140,000 to $185,000, placed by level as described above
𝗔𝗻𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀: variable compensation that has averaged at least 15% of base, prorated in year one. This is the actual historical average, not a stretch target
𝗘𝗾𝘂𝗶𝘁𝘆: every engineer is on the equity plan
𝗥𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: assessed individually, scaled to your distance from Philadelphia and family size

𝗕𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀: full medical package. Ask us for the current plan details and we will send them
𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Philadelphia, PA, on-site, full-time
𝗧𝗿𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗹: none required, though domestic and international field opportunities exist if you want them

Apply via LinkedIn and we'll reach out to schedule a conversation. Confidential search; your application is fully private.

Department Details

Don't miss this opportunity to join talented team of architects as we build new enterprise AI products and functions. Experience a great work environment and enjoy the satisfaction of helping deliver our healthcare mission.

Job Summary

The Principal AI Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and implementing enterprise AI/ML solutions that improve clinical outcomes, operational efficiency, workforce productivity, and business performance across Sanford. Serves as a technical leader, partnering with business stakeholders, clinical leaders, data teams, and technology teams to translate business challenges into scalable, secure, and compliant AI-enabled solutions.

The Principal AI Architect defines architecture standards, evaluates emerging AI technologies, and ensures solutions align with organizational goals, healthcare regulations, security requirements, and responsible AI principles. Combines expertise in AI, cloud architecture, data platforms, healthcare interoperability, and enterprise integration. The Principal AI Architect designs and implements enterprise AI architectures supporting: Generative AI, Machine Learning, Conversational AI, Intelligent Automation, Predictive Analytics, and Clinical Decision Support. Develops architecture patterns, standards, and reference designs for AI solutions. Creates scalable, resilient, and secure AI platforms across cloud and hybrid environments. Defines integration approaches connecting AI systems with enterprise applications and data platforms.

Designs AI solutions that leverage healthcare data while maintaining privacy and security requirements. Architects integrations with healthcare and business systems such as EHR, ERP, HR, and collaboration platforms. Supports implementation of healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, CDA, DICOM, and X12. Collaborates with data architects and engineers to establish AI-ready data pipelines and governance frameworks.

Ensures AI solutions comply with HIPAA, HITECH, organizational security standards, and healthcare regulatory requirements. Establishes controls for model governance, monitoring, auditability, and responsible AI practices. Conducts architecture reviews and risk assessments for AI initiatives. Partners with cybersecurity, compliance, and privacy teams to mitigate AI-related risks.

Evaluates emerging AI technologies, vendors, platforms, and frameworks. Develops recommendations regarding build-versus-buy decisions. Leads proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives for new AI capabilities. Stays current with healthcare AI trends and industry best practices.

Partners with clinical, operational, and business leaders to identify AI opportunities. Translates complex technical concepts into business-friendly recommendations. Provides architectural guidance to engineers, developers, and data scientists. Participates in architecture governance and strategic planning activities. Contributes to AI education, adoption, and change management efforts across the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical field required. Master’s degree is preferred.

7 years of experience in solution architecture, application architecture, data architecture, or software engineering. 3 years of experience designing AI, machine learning, analytics, or automation solutions. Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Experience designing enterprise integrations using APIs, event-driven architecture, or middleware platforms. Experience working with complex enterprise systems and data environments.

AI and Cloud architecture certifications preferred.

Benefits

Sanford offers an attractive benefits package for qualifying full-time and part-time employees. Depending on eligibility, a variety of benefits include health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, work/life balance benefits, and a generous time off package to maintain a healthy home-work balance. For more information about Total Rewards, visit https://sanfordcareers.com/benefits .

The Principal Architect, Artificial Intelligence defines and drives architecture for our enterprise AI portfolio, including advisor-facing AI workspaces, a centralized AI control plane, and the agentic solutions built on top of both. This role provides architecture leadership across the end-to-end AI product development lifecycle (AI PDLC): discovery and intake, experimentation, design, build, evaluation, certification, deployment, operations, change management, and retirement.

You will establish repeatable governance and engineering patterns so that product teams can onboard to a common, governed path without reinventing controls for each initiative. The role pairs strategic architecture with hands-on depth: evaluating emerging models and frameworks, building reference implementations and proofs of concept, and guiding teams to deliver secure, resilient, observable, and cost-aware AI at scale in a regulated financial services environment.

Focus areas will be calibrated to the successful candidate’s strengths and organizational priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution and Platform Architecture

Own and evolve reference architectures for AI-enabled applications, including user-facing AI workspaces and the agent runtime, data stores, and services behind them.
Define patterns for durable user work: conversational and non-conversational sessions, memory and artifact continuity, graceful degradation, and integration into existing web platforms (identity, entitlements, feature flags).
Architect intent routing, context assembly, and delegation between agents and domain services (A2A and task models), including human-in-the-loop controls and advisory-only boundaries so no unintended automated actions occur.
Define experience architecture with product and UX partners: structured response rendering, latency budgets, streaming, error recovery, and multi-intent interactions.
Partner on non-functional requirements: availability, deployment strategy, capacity, performance testing, and disaster recovery from pilot through scale-out.

Enterprise AI Control Plane and Integration

Define how AI products conform to a governed perimeter: API/SDK integration, AI gateway routing, policy enforcement, managed model inference, audit logging, and cost attribution.
Architect registry and lifecycle patterns for models, prompts, tools (including MCP), and agents (e.g., Draft → Active → Suspended → Retired), including version promotion and kill-switch capability.
Establish runtime controls: entitlements, governed tool and agent execution, rate limiting, pause/quarantine/kill mechanisms, and incident evidence capture.
Specify reusable platform services, such as memory, knowledge and RAG abstractions, evaluation hooks, and observability contracts, that reduce duplication across teams.

AI Product Development Lifecycle and Governance

Lead or co-own the architecture of a repeatable path from use-case intake through production certification, ongoing change and exception management, periodic review, and retirement.
Define classification and risk-tiering models that determine the evidence, evaluations, approvals, and identity steps required for each solution type.
Establish production readiness gates: offline and runtime evaluation requirements, regression suites, red-team and safety standards, release evidence, and operational runbooks.
Publish onboarding playbooks for internal teams and approved third parties, replacing one-off project checklists with consistent guidance.
Align AI architecture with Enterprise Architecture, API and event review, security, risk, and compliance forums, and represent AI designs in architecture review cycles.

Security, Evaluation, and Operations

Define security architecture for AI solutions: SSO and token flows, scoped agent identity with delegated authorization, gateway validation, least-privilege tool access, PII protection at egress, content safety, and records retention for transcripts and generated content.
Set standards for evaluation, including groundedness, hallucination, safety, and agent behavior, and for context and memory, semantic retrieval, and enterprise data access (authorization, lineage, abstraction).
Lead LLMOps and AgentOps: versioning, deployment, monitoring, release management, FinOps (token and cost governance), and continuous improvement driven by production telemetry.

Technical Leadership

Define reference architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, RAG, tool-enabled and multi-agent solutions, and MCP/A2A interoperability.
Run technology radar activities: POCs for models, agent frameworks, gateways, and evaluation tooling, and transition successful ones into reference implementations and platform roadmap input.
Mentor solution and software architects, influence roadmaps, and communicate tradeoffs to senior product, engineering, and risk stakeholders.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Required Qualifications

10+ years in enterprise, platform, or software architecture (distributed systems, cloud-native, data-intensive systems).
2+ years architecting generative AI, agentic AI, or ML platforms from experiment through regulated or enterprise production.
2+ years demonstrated ownership of AI product lifecycle outcomes, spanning governance, security, evaluation, and operations in addition to models.
2+ years hands-on credibility with AI applications, agents, RAG, APIs, integrations, and technical POCs, and the ability to review code and designs with engineering teams.
7+ years strong command of cloud-native design: microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, containers/Kubernetes, IAM, observability, resilience, and performance.

Preferred Qualifications

Depth in AWS: EKS, Amazon Bedrock, API Gateway, IAM, data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3), and observability tooling.
Experience with AI gateways and OpenAI-compatible inference APIs.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join Salesforce Professional Services as a Solution Architect championing our PACE (Product, Automotive, Consumer, Energy) organization. You’ll serve as a trusted strategic advisor and platform expert focusing on Agentforce Contact Center for our largest, most complex enterprise customers.

The Sr. Solution Architect leads one or more workstreams in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key collaborators to drive and achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors, using strong communication skills, solution and/or technical knowledge, Salesforce product knowledge, industry experience, consulting experience, and knowledge of their client’s business to deliver customer return on investment.

Solution Architects are strong presenters and facilitators that are able to co-create the vision and own the execution with the customer as well as acquire customer acceptance of the delivered solution. They are capable of driving difficult conversations and removing roadblocks to implement the business strategies. They are proficient at analyzing issues and obstacles to resolve root cause, and can identify appropriate corrective action. They connect with technical and business customers from all levels through C-suite. On a day to day basis, they interact with customer product owner, business process owner and technical resources to understand requirements, analyze information, and craft comprehensive solutions. They also show a strong understanding of typical business challenges or common objectives faced by customers within the industry.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Serve as a strategic, trusted advisor for our PACE (Product, Automotive, Consumer, Energy) industry clients, leveraging deep expertise in Agentforce Contact Center
Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value
Guiding agents to support delivery outcomes
Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking across various levels of a client organization
Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution
Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward
Drive a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies to enable technologies including the Salesforce platform

You’re Our Person If…

Extensive experience with configuration and customization with Agentforce Contact Center
Ability to drive agentic delivery, with experience in AI toolchains (eg. Claude, Cursor, Elements Cloud, etc.)
Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
Experience leading discovery sessions, defining business requirements, writing user stories and providing detailed system and functional designs
Experience in documenting business processes and wire-framing system designs using process flow diagram tools, UML, sequence diagrams, etc. as well as making recommendations for future state improved processes and system designs
Strong presentation skills; able to effectively present a point of view and clearly articulate the rationale to a variety of stakeholders
Detail-oriented individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience
Must be a team player as demonstrated through a customer qualification of a large scale/enterprise implementation with multiple work streams
A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
Travel up to 50%

Even Better If…

Bachelor’s degree (or its foreign degree equivalent) in a Technology, Engineering (any field) or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent demonstrable work experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
Proven results in delivering high value business outcomes utilizing an agile approach
Proven results leading customer and/or partner success stories
Relevant Salesforce certifications & Accreditations
Consulting experience is strongly recommended

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

While we’re headquartered in sunny Arizona, we’ve always got travel on our minds. We’re in the business of creating transformational technology and business solutions using our decades of expertise creating unique travel programs and products combined with next generation technology.

Open Network Exchange (ONE) is seeking a hands-on Enterprise AI Architect to lead the design, integration, and governance of artificial intelligence solutions across the organization.

This individual will establish the technical foundation for ONE's AI strategy, working closely with departmental AI Champions, business leaders, IT, and external partners to implement scalable, secure, and cost-effective AI solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with business acumen and is capable of building AI solutions while establishing the architecture, standards, and controls needed to support AI adoption across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Development

Design and maintain ONE's enterprise AI architecture.
Build and deploy AI applications, agents, and automated workflows.
Establish reusable development frameworks and technical standards.
Lead complex AI implementations and system integrations.

Enterprise Systems Integration

Integrate AI solutions with NICE CXone, Cognigy, Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms.
Develop secure connections to company data, call transcripts, and internal knowledge repositories.
Ensure data accuracy, access permissions, and integration reliability.

AI Governance & Security

Establish AI governance standards, approved technologies, and data-handling requirements.
Implement access controls, testing, monitoring, and audit processes.
Partner with IT and Security to maintain PCI DSS, SOC 2, and applicable compliance requirements.

Automation & Business Enablement

Partner with departmental AI Champions to identify and implement automation opportunities.
Develop AI solutions that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
Build employee productivity tools for email, meetings, task management, and information retrieval.
Evaluate AI initiatives based on feasibility, cost, and business impact.

Evaluate AI technologies, platforms, vendors, and development tools.
Maintain an enterprise AI roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Monitor AI performance, usage, reliability, and costs.
Identify opportunities to consolidate technology and reduce expenses.
Report implementation progress, risks, and results to IT leadership.

Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications and automation solutions.

Strong programming experience with Python and JavaScript.
Experience with REST APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integrations.
Knowledge of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.

Understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and access controls.

Our vision is to enable profitable growth to Aramark's Accounts by providing them with analytical assets that meet their needs as effectively and then efficiently as possible. To achieve this vision, Aramark will deliver strategic data assets that enable our operators to maximize the hospitality experience for our consumers and clients.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team as a key technical contributor on the Document Intelligence Worker platform ? a cloud-native, event-driven system that ingests, classifies, and processes documents at scale using AI agentic workflows. You will design and operate the pipelines and services that power automated document understanding and downstream analytics and AI-driven capabilities across Aramark, processing 1000+ documents per month for 12+ Lines of Business. You will work across Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps Jobs, AI Search, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry.

This is a hybrid role based at our Philadelphia headquarters. Candidates must be local to the area or willing to relocate, and able to work onsite in a hybrid capacity.

Job Responsibilities

Design, build, and own components of the Document Intelligence Worker pipeline, including ingestion, classification, extraction, and downstream delivery to consumer applications, making design decisions that account for scalability, cost, and reliability.
Architect and implement event-driven processing using Azure Blob Storage, Event Grid, and Service Bus, with Container Apps Jobs scaled via KEDA.
Build and productionize AI agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry ? including orchestration, tool use, and multi-step reasoning over unstructured documents.
Implement and maintain retrieval and indexing layers using Azure AI Search and Cosmos DB to support downstream search, analytics, and agentic retrieval.
Design and build the application layer for agentic AI solutions ? backend services and APIs (including authentication and orchestration between the UI and platform services) and React-based user interfaces such as chat, document review/approval tools, and agent monitoring dashboards.
Own monitoring, observability, testing, and recovery mechanisms for production pipelines, including on-call support for critical incidents.
Drive integration and synchronization work between source systems (on-premises and SaaS) and cloud-native platforms, working through dependencies across teams.
Contribute to data engineering best practices ? CI/CD for data and services, testing standards, and code and design review norms ? and mentor junior and mid-level engineers and interns.
Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and cost, translating requirements into reliable, scalable data and AI services and explaining complex AI and data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Evaluate and prototype emerging document intelligence and agentic AI techniques, and recommend their adoption where they add measurable value, weighing cost and risk.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with 8+ years (or 6+ with an MS) of professional experience across data engineering and software development (including full-stack development with backend services), including 3+ years of hands-on experience building applied AI, machine learning, or data science solutions, with production experience building LLM-powered and AI agentic applications, plus experience in document intelligence (OCR, IDP, document classification/extraction). Full-stack development experience, including backend services and API design (e.g., REST, authentication/authorization, service-to-service integration) and React frontend development, sufficient to build UIs for agentic AI applications (e.g., chat interfaces, document review/approval tools, agent monitoring dashboards).
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with production experience building and operating data or AI services.
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including object storage, event-driven messaging, and container orchestration with autoscaling. Experience with Azure services (Blob Storage, Event Grid, Service Bus, Container Apps, KEDA) is preferred.
Experience building or integrating AI agentic workflows and LLM-enabled applications ? e.g., via Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or comparable frameworks.
Experience with document intelligence / intelligent document processing tooling (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, OCR pipelines, layout- or vision-based extraction models).
Experience with vector search and retrieval-augmented generation, including Azure AI Search or equivalent (e.g., Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate).
Experience with NoSQL/document databases such as Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, or Firestore, and designing data models for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
Solid grounding in CI/CD practices, version control (Git), automated testing, and production monitoring/observability.
Comfortable working across distributed teams, with a track record of working with both engineers and non-technical business stakeholders and adapting communication to the audience.

Experience with dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks for downstream data transformation and analytics.
Experience with Apache Spark, real-time streaming, or large-scale distributed data processing.
Experience designing multi-agent orchestration systems, including tool-calling, memory, and agent-to-agent communication patterns.
Prior experience in food service, hospitality, retail, or other consumer-facing industries.

Customer site .

NGA has the right tools (JEMA, FADE, MAVEN, Maven Smart System (MSS), PHOEBE, Esri) and a growing portfolio of analytic capabilities. What it needs are engineers who can connect them. This role exists to close the integration and automation gaps that keep powerful AI capabilities from reaching the analysts who need them.

This is not a back-office development role. You'll be an engineer embedded at the intersection of enterprise technology and live intelligence operations roughly 80% focused on enterprise integration and 20% engaging w analytic units. You'll work with requirements personnel to understand requirements and objectives, map end-to-end workflows, find where manual handoffs create latency, and then architect and build the pipelines, APIs, and AI-enabled applications that eliminate them. You'll prototype fast, take feedback, and harden what works into enterprise-grade capability.

You'll work with Large Language Models (LLMs), Visual Language Models (VLMs), and agentic AI to deliver capabilities analysts can actually use.

You'll be the engineer who turns disconnected AI capabilities into analyst-trusted automation.

What You'll Actually Do

Integrate the NGA AI Stack Into Mission Workflows

Support modernization activities in accordance with Department of War (DoW) AI strategy to systematically close GEOINT workflow gaps
Architect and implement end-to-end automated workflows across the analytic capabilities to develop pipelines, linking COTS and GOTS tools into coherent, mission-specific capabilities.
Use existing APIs, develop new APIs, and implement data interface services that enable seamless interoperability between disparate NGA systems
Design integrations that are modular, scalable, and maintainable—enterprise-level capability, not another stovepipe

Build Data Pipelines and Applications

Design, implement, and maintain robust data ingestion and egress pipelines that give analysts access to underexploited multi-int data sources at BIG DATA scale
Develop operational dashboards, data processing pipelines, and advanced geospatial data visualizations
Integrate front-end applications with underlying data stores, and upgrade, enhance, and integrate third-party applications so they remain performant, secure, and mission-aligned
Build, deploy, and sustain containerized, scalable architectures across cloud and on-premises environments

Engineer AI-Enabled Capabilities

Apply LLMs, VLMs, and generative AI to accelerate tool development and enhance analyst workflows through prompt engineering, model orchestration, and agentic AI pipeline design
Build natural language tasking interfaces and automated assessment generation from computer vision detections
Enable machine-assisted object management population that automatically creates and enriches observation records from model outputs so analysts review, refine, and disseminate rather than build from scratch

At Everforth ECS, we don't just deliver technology solutions—we empower the people behind national security missions. Our culture is built on our core values (GRIT, EXCELLENCE, DRIVE, and COMMUNITY) which cultivates innovation, collaboration, and genuine care for both our employees and the critical work they do. We believe that exceptional outcomes are only possible when talented individuals work in an environment that values their growth, respects their expertise, and celebrates their contributions.

Everforth ECS is proud to be a trusted partner in supporting NGA's modernization activities, aligned with Department of War (DoW) AI guidance and strategy. As an AI Engineer with Everforth ECS, you'll join a team that combines cutting-edge technical expertise with deep mission understanding within a culture that prioritizes work-life balance, professional development, and meaningful impact.

What Makes Everforth ECS Different

People-First Culture: We invest in our employees' success through continuous learning opportunities, mentorship programs, and clear career progression pathways
Innovation Encouraged: We celebrate creative problem-solving and empower our teams to propose and implement bold solutions
Mission Impact: Work on programs that directly support national security, where your contributions make a tangible difference
Collaborative Environment: Cross-functional teams that break down silos and leverage diverse expertise to solve complex challenges
Work-Life Balance: We recognize that sustainable excellence requires reasonable hours, flexibility, and support for personal well-being

Salary Range: 150,000-250,000

General Description Of Benefits

Required Skills

Active TS/SCI with polygraph and ability to obtain TS/SCI with lifestyle polygraph
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated experience developing, integrating, and troubleshooting software solutions within GEOINT environments

This individual will partner closely with Product Owners, engineering teams, enterprise architecture, data teams, business-system owners, and technology vendors to align dependencies and move solutions safely from concept through implementation.

Maintain Conduit’s target architecture, technical roadmap, integration principles, and architectural decision records.
